claim: Vanna is a proprietary derivative trading protocol designed for composability, leverage, and hedging.
Vanna is built on Ethereum Layer 2 networks: Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism.
Two-sided protocol model: Passive liquidity providers supply pooled funds to earn APY without impermanent loss.
Leverage takers borrow pooled liquidity undercollateralized via isolated Margin Accounts to trade options, futures, and spot markets.
Isolated Margin Accounts restrict withdrawals to permitted derivative contracts to protect pooled liquidity.
Prop Dashboard provides real-time visualization of active derivative positions and Greeks for structured hedging.
Supports advanced hedging strategies including Covered Calls, Strangles, and Short Gamma positioning.
Liquidation management protocols safeguard lender capital by monitoring margin account solvency.
Vanna operates on Stellar Soroban or uses Freighter wallet
Vanna integrates with Blend, Aquarius, or Soroswap
